about.title: About Souqly
about.intro: Souqly is a marketplace built on an old idea: the souq, where many independent traders share one busy street and shoppers find everything in one walk.

sections.p: Small shops make the best things — but online, they are scattered across social pages and chat groups, and buyers can't tell who to trust. Souqly gives every shop a proper storefront and gives every shopper one safe place to buy from many of them.
On Souqly you can fill one cart from several shops and check out once. Each shop ships its part of your order, and you can follow every parcel from a single orders page.
Sellers are reviewed before they go live, ratings come only from real orders, and cash on delivery is available across the country. If something goes wrong, our support team steps in.

sections.h: Made for Pakistan and the Gulf
sections.p: Souqly speaks English, Urdu and Arabic, shows prices in your currency, and works smoothly on mobile data. Install it to your home screen and it feels like an app.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms explain the rules for using Souqly as a shopper or as a seller. By creating an account you agree to them.

sections.p: You must give accurate information and keep your password safe. You are responsible for activity on your account. You can close your account at any time from Privacy & data.

Each product is sold by the shop that lists it. Souqly runs the marketplace, processes payments and helps resolve disputes, but the seller is responsible for the product, its description and delivery.

Sellers must list only items they are allowed to sell, describe them honestly, ship on time and honour returns under our returns policy. Commissions and fees are shown in Seller Center before you agree to them.
Counterfeits, illegal or dangerous goods, fake reviews, harassment and attempts to move payments off Souqly are not allowed and can lead to suspension.
Souqly is provided as is. We may update these terms; if a change is significant we will tell you before it takes effect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We collect only what we need to run the marketplace, protect your account and deliver your orders — and we never sell your personal data.

sections.p: Your name, contact details, delivery addresses, orders, and basic device information such as browser type and IP address used to keep your account secure.
To process and deliver orders, let sellers fulfil them, prevent fraud, provide support and — only if you allow it — personalise recommendations and send offers.
A seller only receives the details needed to fulfil your order with them: your name, delivery address and phone number.
You can change notification and privacy settings, download your data or delete your account at any time from your account pages.
Passwords are stored hashed, sessions can be reviewed and revoked, and two-step verification is available for every account.

help.title: Help centre
help.intro: Answers to the questions shoppers and sellers ask us most.

faqs.q: How does cash on delivery work?
faqs.a: Choose Cash on delivery at checkout and pay the rider when your parcel arrives. Please keep the exact amount ready where possible.

faqs.q: Why did my order arrive in more than one parcel?
faqs.a: On Souqly you can buy from several shops at once. Each shop packs and ships its own items, so you may receive more than one parcel. You can track each one from your orders page.

faqs.q: How do I return an item?
faqs.a: Open the order, choose Request a return, and tell us what went wrong. The seller will respond, and our team steps in if you can't agree.

faqs.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
faqs.a: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. We'll email you a secure link that works once. You can also sign in with a one-time code sent to your phone.

faqs.q: How do I keep my account secure?
faqs.a: Use a unique password, turn on two-step verification in Login & security, and sign out of devices you don't recognise.
Switch to seller mode from your account menu, or visit Sell on Souqly. You'll set up your shop name, payout details and first products.

help.chatBody: For questions about a product or delivery, message the shop directly from the product or order page.
help.emailBody: For account, payment or safety issues, write to us and we'll reply within one working day.
